fgn.member_seed_rule: ens_seed*1000003 + 59 + m, re-seeded at the start of every trajectory
fgn.eps_convention: one eps ~ N(0,1)^k per (member, roll step), SHARED across every pixel of that step and resampled at each step — FGN's own rollout convention (arXiv:2506.10772)
fgn.scope_blocks_are: the ensemble MEAN field, through the unchanged accumulate/skill_block path
fgn.amoc_bands_are: the ensemble-mean transport (read_sv is affine in the section mean, so the mean of the member reads is the read of the mean state)
fgn.amoc_bands_unpooled_are: the ensemble MEAN OF THE READ — the learned attention pool is not affine, so this is not the read of the ensemble-mean state; it is the exact mean of the member array in amoc_bands_ens_unpooled

dip.rule: deseasonalised transport below -1 sigma, sigma = std of rv_des over the TRAIN rows of the RAPID series (~t_hold), the same series and the same climatology the bands are correlated against

eigen.note: |lambda| < 1 for every mode means the forecast relaxes to the training mean (climatology in this standardized space) as the lead grows, which is what makes msss_clim approach 0 rather than diverge. A radius at or above 1 invalidates every long-lead row in this entry.
